scope: One B3 seed-2024 run only; historical B0 data and detector reused, no new B0 calls or ablations
selection_reason: Complete historical baseline with enabled GCAD and consistent train/validation counts; chosen before new B3 results. SP daytime baseline disables GCAD and SP multiple archive has inconsistent split counts, so neither is silently treated as an equivalent complete baseline.
prompt: Exact archived non-example content including GSS, enabled GCAD and original environment-aware constraints. Only source examples replaced by original SSC joint I+J output. No forced enhanced quota, no refill.
rasr: Unchanged C/T/S and insertion/replacement algorithms; window 2, decay 0.8, at most two semantic and two statistical attempts per original training parent; no independent generator.

conditional_tuning.trigger: Original-protocol B3 does not exceed historical F1
conditional_tuning.method: Same existing-detector search as prior US-ST/FR-ST, shared across historical/B3 generated-normal pools and three grouped holdouts; no new Codex calls
conditional_tuning.task_adapter: Original night detector uses quadruple hour field index 1, not actions. Coverage, scoring and proxy mutation all use that same field; network and loss unchanged.
conditional_tuning.proxy: Uniform one-field substitution using legal dictionary hour values unseen in each normal generated pool; not real anomaly labels. If either pool has no unseen values, stop without changing search or inventing proxies.
conditional_tuning.selection: Mean proxy F1 over both pools and seeds 2024/2025/2026; ties normal mean loss then existing deterministic original-parameter proximity rule
conditional_tuning.lock: Write selection hash before final refits and one post-lock test scoring; preserve every candidate and negative result
conditional_tuning.limits: Exploratory on historically exposed tests; changed detector protocol kept separate. Formal status is a human designation, not statistical significance or isolated RaSR proof. No test-label parameter selection.

prior_large_backups: All three GitHub assets verified by exact SHA-256 and bytes before any new generation
